newsitem.title: USA: Occidental Petrolem profits jump nearly 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Occidental Petrolem profits jump nearly 40 pct.

text.p: Occidental Petroleum Corp. said Thursday its earnings jumped nearly 40 percent in the latest quarter, helped by higher prices for crude oil and domestic natural gas.

The company said it earned $194 million, or 53 cents a share, in the third quarter, up from earnings of $139 million, or 36 cents a share, a year ago. Revenues rose to $2.88 billion from $2.55 billion.

The Los Angeles-based firm, which is also a chemical producer, said its third-quarter results included a $100 million benefit from a cut in federal income taxes and a $105 million charge to write down its investment in an oil and gas project in Russia.

"Our Oil and Gas division continued the excellent performance of the first six months," said Dr. Ray Irani, chairman and chief executive officer. "Chemical earnings continued to improve from the levels in the first and second quarters."
Occidental's stock was up 12.5 cents at $25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
